subject: Senior Full-Stack Developer — role details
body:
Hi Eventikk team,

I saw your remote Senior Full-Stack Developer opening for Pakistan. I build production products with React, TypeScript and Node.js, including billing, booking interfaces and analytics. Your venue ERP looks relevant to that experience.

Could you share the full job description and the main experience requirements, and confirm whether you are still hiring for this role?

My work: https://itsubaidullahomer.com

Thanks,
Ubaidullah Omer
